voiceover: Your website loads perfectly. But only for you. That's because your app is running on 127.0.0.1, your own computer's address for talking to itself. It's called localhost. Nobody else can reach it. To show the world, you deploy it to a server with a public address. Until then, there's no place like 127.0.0.1. Send this to the dev who keeps texting friends a localhost link.
